changeSet.author: uzinfocom
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE system_settings SET setting_key = replace(setting_key, '.aircontrol.', '.air-control.'), description = replace(description, 'AIRCONTROL', 'AIR_CONTROL') WHERE (setting_key LIKE 'integration.aircontrol.%' OR setting_key LIKE 'http-client.aircontrol.%') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM system_settings existing WHERE existing.setting_key = replace(system_settings.setting_key, '.aircontrol.', '.air-control.'));
UPDATE security_route_policy SET description = replace(description, 'AIRCONTROL', 'AIR_CONTROL') WHERE pattern = '/v1/air-quality/**';

rollback.sql:
UPDATE system_settings SET setting_key = replace(setting_key, '.air-control.', '.aircontrol.'), description = replace(description, 'AIR_CONTROL', 'AIRCONTROL') WHERE setting_key LIKE 'integration.air-control.%' OR setting_key LIKE 'http-client.air-control.%';
UPDATE security_route_policy SET description = replace(description, 'AIR_CONTROL', 'AIRCONTROL') WHERE pattern = '/v1/air-quality/**';
